candidate.sampling_unit: trap-coordinate × trapping bout × trap night, or plot × night for robust effort aggregation
candidate.target: one common species with verified capture coding, selected before fitting occupancy models

candidate.effort: must retain traps with valid deployment and no capture; exclude impractical sampling and invalid trap states
candidate.geography: plot-level NEON coordinates initially; individual trap geolocation must be qualified separately due documented errors

confirm join cardinality and duplicate nightuid logic; never naively join many-to-many
confirm unique plot/bout/night/trap keys and valid effort-only records
confirm same trap surveyed on >=2 distinct nights within bout
confirm sampling and species identity before zero-filling
flag trap-coordinate geolocation issue before spatial modeling
fit detection model only after source passes checks
limits: NEON is a real repeated-night sampling candidate but no raw files were ingested yet
three-night pathogen grids only; one-night diversity grids cannot identify within-bout detection
plot center coordinates do not justify meter-scale trap geography
